description: User profile endpoint for displaying user-specific information. Parametrized endpoint using userId (in various formats: MongoDB ObjectId or numeric). GET request returns HTML profile page with user greeting. POST requests may be used for profile updates.
notes: Potential IDOR (Insecure Direct Object Reference) vulnerability - the endpoint accepts userId parameter in the URL path. Endpoint returns 200 for both valid and potentially invalid UserIds. No apparent authentication check visible. This could allow attackers to: access other users' profiles, enumerate valid userIds, perform horizontal privilege escalation. Requires further testing with different userId values and authentication states.
